title: Memory leak leads to OOM kill
symptoms: Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (java) total-vm. Container OOMKilled, exit code 137. Memory usage climbs steadily for hours before each restart.
root_cause: The application leaks memory (unbounded cache, growing lists, unclosed resources) until the kernel or Kubernetes kills it.
impact: The service restarts repeatedly; in-flight requests fail at each kill.
fix_steps: Confirm with dmesg | grep -i oom or kubectl describe pod (Last State: OOMKilled).
Take a heap dump before the next kill.
Raise the memory limit temporarily to buy time.
Roll back to the last version without the leak if it started after a deploy.
prevention: Set memory limits and alerts at 80%, load-test new releases, and bound all caches.
